indicator_name: IMF Government Finance Statistics: statement of operations, general government and subsectors, billion KZT
description: Статистика госфинансов МВФ (GFS): отчёт об операциях сектора госуправления и подсекторов, млрд тенге
methodology: GFSM 2014: revenue G1 (taxes G11, social contributions G12, grants G13, other G14), expense G2 (G21 compensation … G28 other), net acquisition of nonfinancial assets G31, net lending/borrowing GNLB, financial assets/liabilities transactions. Item = sector . indicator (S13 general government, S1311 central government incl. the National Fund, S1313MIXED local government …). Annual to 2023 (the IMF's latest).
